features.text: PDAC APPROVED L3260: Classified surgical shoe for post-op protection and trauma care.
RIGID ROCKER SOLE: Limits unwanted motion and supports a more natural step during healing.
ADJUSTABLE STRAPS: Hook-and-loop closures accommodate swelling and bulky dressings.
OPEN, BREATHABLE DESIGN: Easy on and off while fitting over bandages for wound access.
UNIVERSAL FIT: Ambidextrous shoe works on left or right foot for flexible use.
CUSHIONED SUPPORT: Forefoot and instep padding enhance comfort during extended wear.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
